crossRefs.note: Rejoice in Yahweh, you righteous! Praise is fitting for the upright.
Sing praises to God! Sing praises! Sing praises to our King! Sing praises!
For God is the King of all the earth. Sing praises with understanding.
Sing to Yahweh a new song! Sing to Yahweh, all the earth.
Sing to Yahweh! Bless his name! Proclaim his salvation from day to day!
Praise Yah! Praise Yahweh from the heavens! Praise him in the heights!
let them praise Yahweh’s name, for his name alone is exalted. His glory is above the earth and the heavens.

For Yahweh has chosen Zion. He has desired it for his habitation.
“This is my resting place forever. I will live here, for I have desired it.

Come, and see God’s deeds— awesome work on behalf of the children of men.

people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: Sing praises to Yahweh, who dwells in Zion, and declare among the people what he has done.
translations.bsb: Sing praises to the LORD, who dwells in Zion; proclaim His deeds among the nations.
translations.kjv: Sing praises to the LORD, which dwelleth in Zion: declare among the people his doings.
translations.asv: Sing praises to Jehovah, who dwelleth in Zion: Declare among the people his doings.
